text.en:
The following items of appropriation under section one, subsection C, paragraph (r), of
Commonwealth Act Numbered Three hundred and thirty are amended so as to read as follows:
"10. For the road to barrio Martinez, Tibiao
"10a. For the Culasi-Camancihan barrio road, Culasi
3,844.27
"29. For the Agugaddan barrio school, Pefiablanca
500.00
"17. For the construction of a public bath and toilet at the corner of Ariston Bautista and Itaguyod and Kalahi
streets, Punta, Sta. Ana
8,500.00
"34. For the construction of a public bath and toilet between Ariston Bautista and F. Roxas streets, Punta, Sta.
8,500.00
